# Eindiainsurance

> India's comprehensive insurance comparison platform specializing in overseas travel, health, and life insurance products with IRDAI-regulated coverage for international destinations including USA, Canada, Schengen countries, and Asia.

Eindiainsurance helps Indian travelers and residents compare and purchase insurance policies from leading providers like Edelweiss Tokio, Future Generali, Royal Sundaram, Care, SBI General, and New India Assurance. The platform specializes in international travel insurance with visa-compliant coverage, multi-trip plans, and senior citizen options.
